At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], along with [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[R2-D2/Legends|RD-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], were sent to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to investigate the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence; however, they were captured and an elite team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] operatives were dispatched to rescue them.<ref name="TS" />
